caseStudies.title: MedQuest — Doctor Anywhere's medication platform
caseStudies.description: MedQuest brings two systems together: OMS turns a paid prescription into a delivered order across the pharmacy floor, and IMS unifies 400+ SKUs into a single source of truth. Grounded in field research, a live PFC trial run, and production UI.

chatbot.title: Case Study — OMS × IMS Medication Platform
chatbot.answer: This two-part case study covers OMS (Order Management System) and IMS (Inventory Management System) at Doctor Anywhere. OMS digitises the pharmacy fulfilment floor — turning a paid prescription into a delivered order — and was validated in a live PFC trial run. IMS ends the '1 drug = 8 records' problem by making one item master the single source of truth that OMS, Provider Web, and the patient app read from.
